svg.title: Lord of Rest from Strife: Four of Swords · Jupiter in Libra · Chesed (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Jupiter above the painting and Libra below, as Book T places them: "Above and below, on the points of two small daggers, are Jupiter and Libra, representing the Decanate." The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/grammars/1791669716863-o403f9hc57.jpg (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
